about: Hand-held props (tools/make_props.py), modelled in the grip frame: +Y along the handle, +Z where the fingers point, +X out of the palm; hand R or L. grip: how the hand closes (skeleton.json hands curls). support: the segment of the handle the left hand may hold when a clip's two_hands names the prop. string: a bow string's ends (the figure draws it, through the drawing hand, and nocks the arrow prop). low_turn: degrees the prop turns about its handle in a lower hand (L2, R2: the forearm held forward in its guard), mirrored on the right. hang: the axis that points down whatever the hand's turn (a bail's load hangs). blade: the striking part along +Y (from, to), kept out of the head. upright: the axis the wrist turns to keep up (grip flat: the hand left open). carry: where the wrist goes, from the lower spine (the arm reaches there). arrow_arm: the arrow's length per bow-arm length; length: a prop's own. data/clips.json hold says which clip holds what.
